songs.title: FIVE : THIRTY
songs.verdict: A three-minute house single from a Beirut project that otherwise works in long minimal and tech-house cuts.
songs.body:
THE MASKING TAPES is a Beirut, Lebanon-based electronic project whose Bandcamp tags it minimal house, tech house and house music.
FIVE : THIRTY is a self-released house single (about 3:07) that came out on 6 Jan 2025.
songs.scout_note: From Marku's Apple Music library (47 plays): 6.8K Spotify monthly listeners; self-released (℗ 2025 THE MASKING TAPES), no label. Lane: Beirut minimal/tech house. Sources: Spotify track/artist pages; Apple album https://music.apple.com/us/album/five-thirty-single/1788871213 (genre House); Bandcamp https://themaskingtapes.bandcamp.com/album/the-masking-tapes-vol-1 (Beirut, tags). Doubts: the Bandcamp page doesn't list FIVE : THIRTY. I matched it to the same act through the name and the track MARI, which appears both on Bandcamp and as an Apple single. No bio, producer credit or social links found. Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).

songs.title: U.
songs.verdict: A club tool made by a US house DJ and an Argentine minimal/tech-house producer for Revival New York.
songs.body:
ChaseWest is a US house DJ/producer on the club circuit (FNGRS CRSSD, Insomniac listings); Discip is from Neuquén, Argentina and makes tech house and minimal with hip-hop influences, with releases on Revival NY, Desolat and Take Notes.
U. is one of two tracks on their Dopamine EP (Revival New York, 28 Jul 2023), produced by Discip and ChaseWest.
songs.scout_note: From Marku's Apple Music library (16 plays): ChaseWest has 90,973 Spotify monthly listeners; Discip's count wasn't found because his Spotify page failed to load. Independent dance label Revival New York (℗ 2023). Lane: US/Argentine tech house. Sources: Apple song (from search, title matches 'U. Original Mix - Song by ChaseWest & Discip') and album https://music.apple.com/us/album/dopamine-single/1695609152; YouTube Topic video (credits Discip and ChaseWest as producers); Insomniac pages for both artists. Instagram: @chasewest from his Spotify page; Discip is @discip_dj per Insomniac. Doubts: the Spotify link is the 2-track Dopamine EP, which I believe includes U., but I couldn't get a track-level URL for U. ChaseWest is just under 100K listeners. Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).

songs.title: Maybe the Problem Is Me
songs.verdict: An early bedroom-pop single from a South London alt-R&B artist, released before her first EP.
songs.body:
dexter in the newsagent is Charmaine Ayoku, a South London alt-pop/alt-R&B/bedroom-pop artist of Nigerian descent; she is on Dork's Hype List 2026 and has worked with Jim Legxacy.
Maybe the Problem Is Me is a self-released non-album single from 19 Jan 2021 that came out before her 2021 EP I Do Love a Good Sandwich.
songs.scout_note: From Marku's Apple Music library (11 plays): her main Spotify profile has 108.9K monthly listeners. The single sits on a separate older profile (https://open.spotify.com/artist/1ey2ESMWC5HEj2CmxvD7Mp, 2.6K). Chartmetric says 131.4K. Label: the single is ℗ 2021 independent; Wikipedia lists AWAL / Common Knowledge / Rules the World and a self-released 2025 mixtape. No major deal found. Lane: South London alt-R&B / bedroom pop. Sources: Wikipedia, Dork Hype List 2026, Spotify album https://open.spotify.com/album/0SsPfnh3JLRz8mKRjKD4BB, Apple album https://music.apple.com/us/album/maybe-the-problem-is-me-single/1547581019. Doubts: she is just over ~100K listeners and rising (Rolling Stone feature), so she is borderline underground. Chartmetric lists @dexterinthenewsagent, but no official source confirmed it, so artist_ig is blank. Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).

songs.title: Makeup
songs.verdict: Introspective, minimal R&B from a Riverside singer; the production stays sparse and leaves room for his voice.
songs.body:
Brandon is a singer-songwriter from Riverside, California, with family roots in Trinidad & Tobago; Okayplayer calls his music introspective R&B.
Makeup was written in October 2018, released as a single on 30 Oct 2019, and later included on his debut EP Coming Clean (Oct 2020).
songs.scout_note: From Marku's Apple Music library (15 plays): 63.3K Spotify monthly listeners; self-released (℗ 2023 Brandon), no label named. Lane: Inland Empire introspective R&B. Sources: Ones to Watch Q&A (Riverside; Makeup written Oct 2018; minimal production), Okayplayer feature, Apple single https://music.apple.com/br/album/makeup-single/1702648645?l=en-GB, Apple album Coming Clean https://music.apple.com/br/album/coming-clean/1719882754?l=en-GB, Spotify Coming Clean album (Makeup is track 2). Doubts: the Spotify link is the album, not the track; Marku's library says 2019 album but the single is 2019 and the EP is 2020. No producer credit or Instagram found. Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).

songs.title: Six Million
songs.verdict: Lo-fi house from a German Bandcamp project that blends hip-hop and house.
songs.body:
upper class is a German lo-fi project whose Bandcamp tags it lofi house, lofi hip hop, house and hip-hop.
Six Million is from the 2018 release Haus Vibes for House Wives; Apple lists it under House.
songs.scout_note: From Marku's Apple Music library (10 plays): 87.1K Spotify monthly listeners; self-released on Bandcamp, no label found. Lane: German lo-fi house / lofi hip-hop. Sources: Bandcamp track page (Germany, tags, IG instagram.com/upperclasslofi, SoundCloud soundcloud.com/upperclasslofi), Spotify track/artist, Apple song, Deezer track. Doubts: release date differs by store (Bandcamp/Apple 13 Mar 2018, Spotify/Deezer 28 Jun 2018). No bio or credits; the Bandcamp 'about' text just says 'placeholder'. Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).

songs.title: It's Not Serious
songs.verdict: A US indie-pop single from an artist with a long run of self-released singles and EPs.
songs.body:
Mike Kota is a US indie-pop/indie-rock artist whose releases include the projects Turning a Corner, Through Fire and Rift.
It's Not Serious is a single released 11 Nov 2022.
songs.scout_note: From Marku's follows (@mike_kota) and his Apple Music library: 19,207 Spotify monthly listeners; no label found. Lane: US indie pop/rock. Sources: Spotify track/artist pages (IG instagram.com/mike_kota, X @mike_kota_), Shazam single page https://www.shazam.com/album/1774384602/its-not-serious-single (where the Apple link came from), Dork track page, Viberate. Doubts: no city, producer or sound description for the song found; the Apple link has Shazam's tracking parameters removed and I didn't open it. Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).

songs.title: Can I
songs.verdict: A late-2025 single from a very small US alt-hip-hop act who releases singles often.
songs.body:
BABYKIRA is a US artist that Viberate tags alternative hip-hop, with frequent singles through 2025–26 and guest spots on other artists' projects.
Can I is a single released 28 Nov 2025 on the label 'broke'.
songs.scout_note: From Marku's follows (@babykira) and his Apple Music library: Spotify listeners unknown (Viberate N/A; Deezer shows 36 fans), so clearly underground. Label 'broke' per Shazam, not a major. Lane: US alt hip-hop (Apple keyword: Alternative). Sources: Shazam song page https://www.shazam.com/en-us/song/1854615810/can-i, Apple artist page, Deezer artist page, Viberate. Doubts: very little public bio (no city, no producer credits); no Spotify link or Instagram found. Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).

songs.title: FKA Passat
songs.verdict: A 1:28 sketch from a self-released R&B/soul project: more mood fragment than full song.
songs.body:
Alex Banin is a self-releasing R&B/soul artist whose 2023 single "Doc Whiler" has over 9M Spotify plays.
This is track 4 of the 7-song album Since Winona, a short interlude-length piece.
songs.scout_note: From Marku's Apple Music library (17 plays): Spotify shows 150,474 monthly listeners and 23.5K followers. Apple album copyright is ℗ 2024 Alex Banin (self-released, no label), so keep. Instagram alxbanin and website sincewinona.com are both listed on the Spotify artist page. Sources: Spotify track, album and artist pages; Apple song and album (https://music.apple.com/us/album/since-winona/1744112397). Doubts: no city or bio found. A Max's Music Mondays Substack interview exists but is paywalled. Listener count is just over 100k. Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).

songs.title: Girls
songs.verdict: A 5:26 club tool on Revival New York that Beatport files as 130 BPM indie tech, built for DJs rather than radio.
songs.body:
Dan Molinari is a US house DJ, producer and vocalist. Insomniac describes his sound as raw. His breakout EP was D.O.P.E., and he often collaborates with SLAMM.
"Girls" (Original Mix) is a single, Jan 17, 2025, on Revival New York: an indie-tech groove in E minor at 130 BPM.
songs.scout_note: From Marku's Apple Music library (19 plays): about 64.9K Spotify monthly listeners, independent dance label Revival New York (Apple shows ℗ 2025 Revival New York), so keep. Lane: house / indie tech. Sources: Apple single page, Beatport https://www.beatport.com/track/girls/19969524, the Insomniac artist page (also the source of the Instagram handle), and the Spotify track and artist pages. Doubts: Insomniac doesn't say which city he's based in. Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).

songs.title: Ion Cake
songs.verdict: Opens a six-song tape that Ghostrage produced and engineered for Detroit rapper Kura's melodic, auto-tuned flows.
songs.body:
Kura (Daniel McAllister) is a Detroit rapper and producer known for fast, melodic auto-tuned runs. As a teen he signed with Pi'erre Bourne's SossHouse.
"Ion Cake" is track 1 of 6 Songs - EP, released through Ghostrage LLC with Ghostrage producing.
songs.scout_note: From Marku's Apple Music library (8 plays): Kura has about 50K Spotify monthly listeners and Ghostrage about 16.6K. Shazam lists the label as Ghostrage LLC, so keep. Lane: Detroit melodic trap. Shazam credits Ghostrage as producer/engineer and Daniel McAllister and Chandler Ingram as writers. Sources: Apple song, Shazam (https://www.shazam.com/en-us/song/1771893634/ion-cake), Spotify track, Audiomack (https://audiomack.com/kura/album/ion-cake), and Wikipedia's Kura (musician) page. FLAG: Wikipedia says Kura signed with SossHouse at 17; whether that deal is still active, or tied to a major, is unclear. Release dates disagree: Apple says Nov 1, 2024 and Shazam/Spotify say Nov 15, 2024. The Deezer link (a 'Kura - Ion Cake' single) came from a search result and wasn't fetched. X handle @listen2kura is unconfirmed as official, and no Instagram was found. Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).

songs.title: Feito Fumaça (feat. Ju Strassacapa)
songs.verdict: A feminist trio blends traditional Brazilian rhythms like maracatu, côco, jongo and baião into original songs, here with a guest vocal from Ju Strassacapa.
songs.body:
Obinrin Trio is three Brazilian musicians: Lana Lopes, Elis Menezes and Raíssa Lopes on percussion, guitar and vocals. They formed after Carnaval 2016.
"Feito Fumaça" was written by Raíssa Lopes. It is track 5 on their album Origem, which they released themselves via Tratore.
songs.scout_note: From Marku's Apple Music library (11 plays): about 11.9K Spotify monthly listeners. Shazam lists the label as 'Obinrin Trio [distributed by Tratore]', so self-released. Keep. Sources: Apple song page, Shazam, the Spotify track and artist pages, and Catraca Livre's feature on the trio. Doubts: Spotify now credits the guest as LAZÚLI instead of Ju Strassacapa. A search result title for the same track ID says 'Obinrin Trio, Ju Strassacapa', so it's the same recording. Sources didn't name a city. YouTube videos exist but YouTube was blocked for fetching. Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).

songs.title: Navy Blue
songs.verdict: A short, self-released 2:43 R&B/soul single.
songs.body:
HASANI is a self-releasing R&B/soul artist. Songwriting is credited to Wayne (W. Hasani) Miller.
"Navy Blue" was a standalone single released Nov 8, 2016.
songs.scout_note: From Marku's Apple Music library (16 plays): about 27.3K Spotify monthly listeners. Shazam lists the label as 'Hasani' (self-released). Keep. Sources: Apple song page, Shazam (https://www.shazam.com/song/1275216660/navy-blue), and the Spotify track and artist pages. Doubts: almost no public bio, city or press. The verdict and body are deliberately thin. Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).

songs.title: ZIG ZAGGING
songs.verdict: A short alt-R&B jam: a smooth vocal over a grooving drum loop, sleek bass and gated guitar plucks, as Dusty Organ describes it.
songs.body:
Asha Imuno is an LA-based alt-R&B and rap artist. A Mastercard/OnesToWatch showcase in 2025 featured his WAITINGROOM concept.
"ZIG ZAGGING" is a 2:04 single from May 27, 2022, built around a loose, bass-led groove.
songs.scout_note: From Marku's Apple Music library (12 plays): about 97K Spotify monthly listeners, close to the 100k line. Apple shows '℗ 2022 WAITINGROOM', which appears to be his own imprint or concept; no major found. Keep. Sources: dustyorgan.com/2022/06/02/asha-imuno-shares-blissful-new-single-zig-zagging/, the Apple single page (UA storefront), the Spotify track (fetched with tracking params, which I stripped from the ID URL) and artist page, and onestowatch.com. Doubts: no producer named, and no official Instagram found. Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).

songs.title: K-Hole
songs.verdict: A 1:25 sketch from Juto's Fleece EP: R&B/pop shaped by gospel and pop influences, in miniature.
songs.body:
Juto (Jairus Gay) was born in Springfield, MO, raised in Gwinnett, GA, and is based in LA. He was the first artist signed to Taco Bennett's RE7AX Records, in association with COR/TAN.
"K-Hole" is track 4 of the Fleece EP (Dec 2021), a brief interlude-length cut he wrote himself.
songs.scout_note: From Marku's Apple Music library (22 plays): about 28.7K Spotify monthly listeners. Qobuz lists the label as COR - TAN; Wikipedia says RE7AX Records in association with COR/TAN. Both are indie, so keep. Sources: Apple song page, Spotify track and artist pages, Qobuz (https://www.qobuz.com/gb-en/album/fleece-juto/e8xji271ktz5b; credits Jairus Gay as writer, no producer listed), and en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Juto. Doubts: release date is Dec 17 on Apple but Dec 21 on Spotify/Qobuz. Wikipedia spells his name 'Jarius'. Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).

songs.title: 2S!des
songs.verdict: An 8-song, 24-minute R&B project from a small New Jersey-adjacent underground circle (UoT, SupremeDae, LOM MAZI).
songs.body:
d4mon. is an R&B/soul artist whose circle includes UoT, SupremeDae and LOM MAZI.
2S!des (May 16, 2025) includes "Us", which has its own video, and "Letter2Myself".
songs.scout_note: From Marku's follows (@d4monjr) and his Apple Music library: about 35.5K Spotify monthly listeners. Apple shows '℗ 2025 Moyne', no major found. Keep. IMPORTANT: Apple lists 2S!des as a compilation/album; there is no track called '2S!des'. Marku's library entry probably shows the album name. Consider kind 'album', or reviewing a track like 'Us' (https://music.apple.com/us/album/us/1809213617?i=1809214019). No Spotify album link was found. Sources: Apple artist and album pages and the Spotify artist page. Doubts: no city or bio found. Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).

songs.title: NEW CHANEL (feat. d4mon. & LOM MAZI)
songs.verdict: A three-way posse cut from a New Jersey singer-rapper who has long split the difference between raw bars and melody.
songs.body:
SupremeDae is a singer and rapper from Somerset, New Jersey. Press describes his raw, diary-like lyrics and candid melodies, and he names Drake, Lil Wayne and Kanye West as influences.
"NEW CHANEL" is a roughly three-minute single with d4mon. and LOM MAZI, a trio that also put out "Flawed" together.
songs.scout_note: From Marku's follows (@supremedae) and his Apple Music library: Spotify shows about 38K monthly listeners. Label line is '℗ 2025 Moyne.' with no major attached. Underground NJ rap/R&B. Sources: Apple song and single pages (released Apr 10, 2025, Hip-Hop/Rap); ratingsgamemusic.com 2023 feature (Somerset NJ, gave the Spotify artist link); broadwayworld.com 2022 article (Atlantic A&Rs showed interest, no signing reported). Spotify link left empty: the only Spotify 'NEW CHANEL' I found is a d4mon.-credited single (open.spotify.com/album/3lpHW4hvCRaAoQzwyr60zJ) and I couldn't confirm it's the same release. Apple also has a later 'NEW CHANEL' credited to d4mon., SupremeDae, LOM MAZI & UOT (song 1841636999), which is a different version. No producer info. No official IG found. Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).

songs.title: a-list
songs.verdict: A track from a sprawling DIY concept record by a producer-artist building his own 'Kepler' universe.
songs.body:
HAILE is a DIY producer and artist who uses K442b as an alias, named in the style of exoplanets. He ties his music to an animation and story world, and he runs They Love It There Records, which grew out of Side Quest Studios.
The song comes from call me KEPLER!, a 25-track album released in August 2026.
songs.scout_note: From Marku's Apple Music library (9 plays): very small. The Spotify profiles linked from his Linktree show 10 (K442b) and 33 (HAILE) monthly listeners, which seems low, so those numbers may be stale. Self-run label: '℗ 2026 THEY LOVE IT THERE Records'. DOUBT: the apple_url is the ALBUM page (K442b & HAILE, released Aug 11, 2026, 25 songs, genre Alternative). I could not see a track called 'a-list' in any tracklist I could fetch, so the song link isn't individually verified. Sources: Apple album and artist pages; tristonyaps.substack.com/p/we-love-it-here (K442b is his alias, the label history, LA shows); linktr.ee/ofcourseithaile (source for the IG handle and both Spotify links). Not the UK Haile/WSTRN, who is a different artist. Track confirmed on the album by Marku's own library entry (call me KEPLER!). Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).

songs.title: All The Rage
songs.verdict: A Vancouver band that recycles new-wave and grunge parts into something of its own, on a self-produced indie-label single.
songs.body:
Hotel Decor is a Vancouver collaborative rock project that draws on everything from 1970s new wave to 'cowboy grunge' and tries to build new things out of older music.
"All The Rage" is a March 2021 single, written and produced by Csaba Laszlo and released through Mammal Sounds Records with a video by DualSense Films.
songs.scout_note: From Marku's Apple Music library (10 plays): Spotify shows about 27.5K monthly listeners on indie Mammal Sounds Records. Vancouver rock. Sources: Spotify track page (Mar 24, 2021); Apple song page (Mar 24, 2021; Apple tags it 'House', which looks like bad metadata); official YouTube video description (credits: Csaba Laszlo writing and production, Roberto Angel Dwyer mixing and mastering, DualSense Films video, Mammal Sounds Records); hoteldecor.bandcamp.com (bio, Vancouver, source for the IG handle). The SoundCloud link is from the band's own account per search results; the page couldn't be fetched (robots). The song isn't on their Bandcamp. Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).

songs.title: Keep Your Head Up
songs.verdict: A calm, acoustic, self-produced pep talk from a Virginia artist working between R&B, hip-hop and bedroom pop.
songs.body:
Khi Infinite is a Virginia artist who blends R&B, hip-hop and bedroom pop. He has worked with Pusha T and CHASE B on 'LIGHTS PLEASE'.
"Keep Your Head Up" was his first release of 2022, a calm, acoustic-leaning track he produced himself, with warm vocals over a restrained instrumental.
songs.scout_note: From Marku's Apple Music library (13 plays): Spotify shows about 57K monthly listeners. Label not found, but he's under the listener line so he qualifies either way. Virginia R&B/rap. Sources: Spotify track page (Apr 28, 2022); the Apple link was taken from his Apple artist page, which lists 'Keep Your Head Up - Single · 2022'; alfitude.com/tag/khi-infinite (self-produced, acoustic, Virginia native). Apple has a second 'Keep Your Head Up' song (1804159545) that wouldn't load, so I didn't use it. The YouTube 'Official Video' link came from search results and wasn't fetched. No official IG found. Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).

songs.title: Shit
songs.verdict: A sub-two-minute blast from a Philadelphia band that tags itself experimental, punk and lo-fi.
songs.body:
Disaster Artist is a Philadelphia act whose Bandcamp tags are experimental, punk, rock and lo-fi.
"SHIT" is track 4 of 13 on the October 2022 album STOMACH PAINS and runs 1:47.
songs.scout_note: From Marku's follows (@disasterartistband) and his Apple Music library: Spotify shows about 4.3K monthly listeners, no label. Philly DIY punk. Sources: disasterartistband.bandcamp.com/album/stomach-pains (Oct 15, 2022; tracklist; Philadelphia; the band bio is just 'placeholder'); Spotify album page STOMACH PAINS (Oct 15, 2022). The spotify_url is the ALBUM, since I couldn't find a track link for 'SHIT'. Apple lists the artist (artist/1605069258) and a Stomach Pains song ('Old Money'), but I didn't get an album or song URL, so apple_url is empty. A musicconnection.com review of a 'Disaster Artist' (art-punk) didn't confirm it's the same act. No IG found. Older release, added from Marku's library (freshness rule waived).
